# GOMAX Ultimate

> GOMAX Ultimate is a pay-once, self-hosted, AI-native operating system for WordPress and WooCommerce. Users connect ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini and run their entire website by chatting — building pages, generating and optimizing images, fixing SEO/GEO, publishing content, managing their shop, and capturing leads — with no subscription and with their data staying on their own site (bring-your-own-AI-key).

## Key facts

- **Model:** Pay once, no subscription. Includes 12 months of updates; optional small yearly renewal afterward.
- **Privacy:** Self-hosted. First-party. Your data never routes through a third-party SaaS. Bring your own AI key (OpenAI / Anthropic / others).
- **Works with:** ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini (and other assistants) — connect the one you already use.
- **Platform:** WordPress + WooCommerce.
- **Maker:** Unlimited Possibilities.

## What it does

- Run a WordPress/WooCommerce site through natural-language chat with an AI assistant (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini), connected via a secure revocable pass.
- Generate premium, agency-grade pages from a single prompt (layout, motion, sections, imagery); compose whole pages from curated recipes; generate on-brand blocks; a premium block library; a cinematic scroll motion engine and interactive/WebGL sections.
- Create AI images and product shots from a text brief, and automatically serve them as fast WebP/AVIF.
- Improve SEO (clean permalinks, XML sitemaps, per-page meta, structured data, IndexNow, redirect manager, 404 monitor, audits) and GEO / Generative Engine Optimization (llms.txt and AI-discovery files, AI crawler access control, AI Readiness scorecard) so the site is found on Google and recommended inside AI assistant answers.
- Keep a WooCommerce store discoverable and shoppable, including by AI shopping agents: machine-readable product catalog, agentic commerce (ACP/UCP-ready), Google/Bing merchant feeds, commerce-readiness scoring.
- Auto-publish SEO-ready articles on a schedule (with full metadata and instant indexing); embed video in posts.
- Run built-in scheduled agents (SEO/GEO, Shop Manager, Growth) that make only reversible changes within a risk budget with atomic rollback; plus Autopilot goals, a self-fixing Doctor, a persistent Site Brain and a workflow engine.
- Provide first-party, privacy-first analytics, lead capture and scoring, and a unified inbox/CRM (forms, chat, email, leads, comments).
- On-site AI chatbot/product advisor, voice agent, two-way email inbox, and social engagement with an approval queue (never auto-posts).
- A site-health suite: SEO, accessibility (WCAG), performance (Core Web Vitals), link-health, database and security auditors; off-site backups (BYOK); cache and HTTPS hygiene.
- Safety: preview, verify and rollback; read/preview/write modes; audit log. Privacy: self-hosted, first-party, bring-your-own-key, pay once, consent and data export/erase.
